report_content_policy.serialized_report_encoding: ASCII subset of UTF-8 via JSON escapes; no BOM

remaining_hebrew_anchor_check.method: After both overlays, extract every remaining Hebrew-script lexical segment from deciding_marker_or_seam; split ellipses. Consonantal mode removes pointing/cantillation/spacing/format controls. Pointed mode removes cantillation, spacing, morph slash, and XML format controls while retaining Hebrew letters, vowel points, dagesh, and shin/sin dots. Require each normalized sequence in both pinned OSHB and UXLC effective MT spans. Ketiv/qere cases are checked separately without collapsing alternatives.

boundary_effect: None. The source-fidelity overlays change only effective wording; all route, review-state, coverage, appeal, relation, and authority fields remain invariant.
